definitions.explanation: Describes a smooth, reflective surface shine.
Describes skin or surfaces that are shiny due to oil.

examples.japanese: ⟦{床|ゆか}→床：03652_yuka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧てかてか⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{磨|みが}いた→磨く：02427_migaku⟧。
examples.english: I polished the floor until it shone.

examples.japanese: ⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧てかてか⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
てかてか⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{新車|しんしゃ}→新車：11334_shinsha⟧。
てかてか⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{光|ひか}る→光る：01163_hikaru⟧⟦{革靴|かわぐつ}→革靴：15433_kawagutsu⟧。

examples.english: In summer, my face easily gets oily.

examples.japanese: てかてか⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{鼻|はな}→鼻：02164_hana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ティッシュ→ティッシュ：08816_tisshu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{押|お}さえた→押さえる：02021_osaeru⟧。
examples.english: I blotted my shiny nose with a tissue.

notes:
てかてか is an onomatopoeic adverb describing a shiny or glossy surface, often with a slightly negative nuance of oiliness or excess shine.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- てかてか⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be shiny/oily
- てかてか⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{磨|みが}く→磨く：02427_migaku⟧: to polish until shiny
- てかてか⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{光|ひか}る→光る：01163_hikaru⟧: to gleam, to shine
- てかてか⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun: a shiny ~

USAGE:
- Positive: freshly polished floors, shiny new items
- Negative: oily/greasy skin (⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧てかてか⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ぴかぴか→ぴかぴか：05155_pikapika⟧: sparkling clean, brand-new (positive nuance)
- ⟦つやつや→つやつや：05888_tsuyatsuya⟧: glossy, lustrous (healthy, attractive shine — hair, skin)
- ⟦ぎらぎら→ぎらぎら：05359_giragira⟧: glaring, dazzling (harsh, unpleasant brightness)
- ⟦てらてら→てらてら：noentry⟧: shiny, greasy (close synonym, slightly more literary)
